multipleChoice.question: What time of day does Chapter 10 begin?
options: Late afternoon
Midday
Early morning
Evening
multipleChoice.explanation: The chapter opens at early morning with the sun slowly rising beyond the sea.

multipleChoice.question: What did James say when he saw the sun rising through the window?
options: He said a prayer for the harvest
He quoted David saying the heavens declare God's glory
He called the children to come and look
He told Martha to prepare food quickly
multipleChoice.explanation: James said that David was right: the heavens declare the glory of God, and God reveals himself through his creation.

multipleChoice.question: What did Matthew bring into the house that morning?
options: Bread and oil
Water from the spring
Two fish
Fruit from the garden
multipleChoice.explanation: Matthew ran into the house bringing two fish.

multipleChoice.question: Why did Matthew call Peter a 'little wolf'?
options: Because Peter was brave
Because Peter was still sleeping when everyone else was up
Because Peter ate too much at breakfast
Because Peter was chasing the donkey
multipleChoice.explanation: Peter was still sleeping while everyone else was already awake, so Matthew laughed and called him 'little wolf.'

multipleChoice.question: What was James planning to do that day?
options: Go to the spring to draw water
Travel to the city
Sow wheat in the field
Build a new room in the house
multipleChoice.explanation: James said he was going to sow wheat because the season for sowing had come.

multipleChoice.question: In the parable James told, what happened to the seed that fell by the road?
options: It grew up quickly but then withered
The birds came and ate it
It was choked by thorns
It bore much fruit
multipleChoice.explanation: The seed that fell by the road was eaten by the birds of the sky.

multipleChoice.question: What did Peter do when he heard about the birds eating the seed?
options: He ran outside to chase birds
He covered his ears with his hands
He started to cry
He laughed at the story
multipleChoice.explanation: Peter put his hands on his ears, and everyone laughed.

multipleChoice.question: In the parable, what happened to the seed that fell on rocky ground?
options: Birds ate it immediately
It sprang up quickly but withered because it had no root
It was choked by thorns and worries
It bore fruit a hundredfold
multipleChoice.explanation: The seed on rocky ground sprang up but withered because it lacked root and moisture.

multipleChoice.question: What did Matthew say about the parable?
options: He said he did not understand it
He said he had already learned it
He said it was a frightening story
He asked James to explain it again
multipleChoice.explanation: Matthew said he had already learned the parable.

multipleChoice.question: Who first told the disciples the meaning of the parable?
options: James
Matthew
Jesus himself
The prophet Isaiah
multipleChoice.explanation: James explains that Jesus himself told his disciples the meaning of the parable.

multipleChoice.question: What did Jesus tell his disciples was given to them but not to others?
options: The power to heal
To know the mysteries of the kingdom of heaven
To sow the word in every land
To see the signs in the sky
multipleChoice.explanation: Jesus told his disciples: 'To you it is given to know the mysteries of the kingdom of heaven.'

multipleChoice.question: What does the rocky ground represent in James's explanation?
options: People who never hear the word
People who hear the word but have no root and fall away
People who are choked by worries
People who bear much fruit
multipleChoice.explanation: Those sown on rock hear the word but have no root; they receive it with joy but then fall away.

multipleChoice.question: What does Peter say he wants to become at the end of the chapter?
options: A sower of seed
A teacher of the word
Good earth
A disciple who travels
multipleChoice.explanation: Peter says 'Father, I want to become good earth.'

multipleChoice.question: What does James do at the very end of the chapter?
options: He goes out to sow the field
He puts his hand on Peter's head and speaks to him
He reads from a scroll
He sends the children to sleep
multipleChoice.explanation: James places his hand on Peter's head and speaks to him.

multipleChoice.question: What does the thorny ground represent?
options: Those who never hear the word at all
Those who hear the word but it is choked by the worries of life
Those who hear with joy and bear fruit
Those who are like birds eating the seed
multipleChoice.explanation: Those sown among thorns hear the word but the worries of life choke it.

trueFalse.statement: The sea was stormy at the beginning of the chapter.
trueFalse.explanation: There was a great calm on the sea because there was no wind.

trueFalse.statement: James saw the sunrise through a window.
trueFalse.explanation: James was watching the things happening outside through the window.

trueFalse.statement: Martha prepared the breakfast inside the house.
trueFalse.explanation: Martha was preparing breakfast inside the house and set things on the table.

trueFalse.statement: The rooster crowed only once to wake up the household.
trueFalse.explanation: The rooster crowed again a second time because Peter was still sleeping.

trueFalse.statement: James told Peter that this was a good time to sow wheat.
trueFalse.explanation: James said the season for sowing had come.

trueFalse.statement: All four types of ground in the parable produced fruit.
trueFalse.explanation: Only the good earth produced fruit; the other three types of ground did not.

trueFalse.statement: Jesus taught the parable of the sower by the sea.
trueFalse.explanation: James recounts that Jesus went to the sea, a large crowd gathered, and he sat in a boat to teach.

trueFalse.statement: Peter fully understood the parable the first time James told it.
trueFalse.explanation: Peter said he did not understand the parable.

trueFalse.statement: Even Jesus's own disciples understood the parable at first.
trueFalse.explanation: James says that not even Jesus's disciples knew the parable at first.

trueFalse.statement: Peter closed his eyes and covered his ears when James explained the hard-hearted people.
trueFalse.explanation: Peter closed his eyes and put his hands on his ears to act out what James was describing.

trueFalse.statement: Martha spoke about the worries of life during the explanation.
trueFalse.explanation: Martha said that truly the worries of life are many.

trueFalse.statement: Magdalene did not speak at all during Part B.
trueFalse.explanation: Magdalene asked what Jesus told the disciples, and later added her own comment about the rocky ground.

trueFalse.statement: The good earth represents those who receive the word in their hearts.
trueFalse.explanation: Those sown on good earth are those who receive the word in their hearts.

trueFalse.statement: Peter was confused and unhappy at the end of the chapter.
trueFalse.explanation: At the end, Peter declares he wants to become good earth and is quiet in thought, then speaks with his father.

trueFalse.statement: James said that God reveals himself through his creation.
trueFalse.explanation: In Part A, James says what is known about God is evident through his creation.

yesNo.question: Was Peter awake when the rest of the family was already up?
yesNo.explanation: Peter was still sleeping; the rooster had to crow again and his mother woke him.

yesNo.question: Did James quote scripture when he saw the sunrise?
yesNo.explanation: James quoted David, saying the heavens declare the glory of God.

yesNo.question: Did the seed on good earth bear fruit?
yesNo.explanation: The seed that fell on good earth came up and bore fruit.

yesNo.question: Was James worried about birds eating the wheat he planned to sow?
yesNo.explanation: It was Peter who worried about the birds; James told him not to worry.

yesNo.question: Did the whole family laugh at something Peter did?
yesNo.explanation: When Peter covered his ears with his hands, everyone laughed.

yesNo.question: Did James explain the meaning of all four types of ground?
yesNo.explanation: James, with the family, explained the road, rocky ground, thorny ground, and good earth.

yesNo.question: Did Peter open his eyes when James explained the disciples received understanding?
yesNo.explanation: Peter opened his eyes and said 'Look, I see and I hear!'

yesNo.question: Was the chapter's final focus on Martha's worries about life?
yesNo.explanation: The chapter ends with Peter saying he wants to become good earth and James placing his hand on Peter's head.

yesNo.question: Did Magdalene participate in the family discussion about the parable?
yesNo.explanation: Magdalene asked what Jesus told the disciples and later added her own observation about the rocky ground.

yesNo.question: Did James bless Peter at the end of the chapter?
yesNo.explanation: James placed his hand on Peter's head and spoke to him.
